notes.title: This Game Will Become Free to Play
notes.content:
[p][b]Dear players,[/b][/p][p]Hello.[/p][p]We’ve decided that starting from [b]July 5th, 2025[/b], this game will transition from a paid product to [b]completely free[/b] on Steam. This wasn’t an easy decision, but we believe it is the most appropriate one for where things stand.[/p][p]Over the past period, we sincerely thank everyone who supported, purchased, and experienced this game. We no longer plan to pursue further monetization — there will be no in-game purchases, DLCs, or other commercial content. The game will remain available on Steam as a complete experience, free for all players.[/p][p]This may not be a perfect game, but it was created with a lot of passion. We’ve been fortunate to receive your understanding and support. While there may be no future updates, the game will stay here — a lasting record of the effort we once made.[/p][p]To those who already purchased the game: [b]thank you[/b]. It’s because of you that the game made it this far.
If you have any questions or thoughts regarding this change, feel free to leave a comment — we’ll do our best to respond.[/p][p][b]Thank you for being here, even once.[/b][/p][p]— The Development Team[/p]

notes.title: bug fixes
notes.content: Fixed the delay problem in judging whether to pass the level. Because of this delay problem, you may not pass the level even if you have a plan that is better than the feasible number of actions. Sorry!
